title: Redis Use Cases
description: Explore real-world Redis use cases: session storage, rate limiting, leaderboards, pub/sub, geospatial queries, and bloom filters.
longDescription: Redis is used for far more than simple caching. This module covers session storage, rate limiting, leaderboards, messaging, geospatial indexing, and probabilistic data structures.
whatYouLearn: Store and manage user sessions in Redis
Implement rate limiting with sliding windows
Use bloom filters for membership testing
